# Mintmark

> Mintmark is a public identity and evidence registry for tokenized stocks on BNB Smart Chain.

Canonical product: https://mintmark.nuvixes.studio
Product documentation: https://mintmark.nuvixes.studio/docs
Source code: https://github.com/Nifemi0/mintmark

## Product scope

- Search by company name, public ticker, token symbol, category, keyword, or exact BSC contract.
- Compare distinct Ondo, bStocks, and xStocks products without treating a shared stock ticker as one token.
- Inspect 1,565 checked records: 450 Ondo, 46 bStocks, and 1,069 xStocks.
- Open shareable comparisons with `/?q=NVDA#registry` and exact records with `/?q=NVDA&record=56%3A0x...#record`.
- Review exact-contract token-market coverage from Binance when available: price, 24-hour change, reported volume, reported liquidity, holders, and transaction activity.
- Review underlying-company profiles, market fields, and BSC token candles for supported Binance RWA records.
- Check a wallet read-only against 24 explicitly supported Ondo contracts.

## Public endpoints

- `GET /api/health` — service status, record count, snapshot time, and Binance configuration state.
- `GET /api/records?q=NVDA` — search and compact comparison records.
- `GET /api/record?key=56:0x...` — one exact registry record and its evidence.
- `GET /api/report?key=56:0x...` — exact-contract token-market coverage and, when supported, the underlying-company report.
- `GET /api/history?key=56:0x...` — public versions and unresolved source differences.
- `GET /api/wallet?address=0x...` — read-only lookup over the supported contract subset.

## Evidence semantics

- Identity is always BSC chain ID plus the complete contract address. A ticker is a discovery aid only.
- Onchain observed means Mintmark read contract bytecode, name, or symbol from BSC RPC.
- Issuer published means the provider published the identity or terms.
- Third-party reported means Binance supplied the field.
- Unverified means Mintmark has not independently inspected offchain backing, custody, or legal rights.
- Missing data remains unavailable. Mintmark does not borrow a price or company report from a different token contract.
- Binance market responses are displayed as reported. Missing liquidity and inconsistent volume or transaction counts are surfaced as coverage notes.

## Data sources

- Binance Web3 RWA Data API: https://web3.binance.com/en/dev-docs/catalog/web3-wallet/api/rest-api/rwa-data
- Binance Web3 General Data API: https://web3.binance.com/en/dev-docs/catalog/web3-wallet/api/rest-api/general-data
- Binance Web3 Wallet API: https://web3.binance.com/en/dev-docs/catalog/web3-wallet/api/rest-api/wallet-api
- Ondo contract addresses: https://docs.ondo.finance/addresses
- xStocks public asset API: https://docs.xstocks.fi/apis/openapi/assets/list_public_assets

The catalog is a dated snapshot. Contract checks establish contract responses, not backing or equivalence between provider products. Mintmark does not execute transactions or give investment advice.
